reviews.review: Different and quite fun! Highly enjoyable exploration game. Bring some friends! Nothing quite like this game out there. Beautiful , pretty. and deadly .. this game will challenge you while being the right amount of fun!
Would like a customization option for characters looks and the ability to choose between boy or girl characters please.

This is an instant favorite game in my library. Finally a game that pulls me out of Rust from Facepunch studios! This game is 99% perfect. The following is a reply I left on an ingame-survey, talking about that 1% terrible flaw that I found at 26 hours of gameplay.

SURVEY REPLY:

"I bought the game 2 days ago I believe, and what I briefly read about the game loop made my decision. I have people under my care, and having the chance to play something like this in solo, and being able to pause the game at any moment, and return after is absolutely great. 

However... let me tell you about this last the game session that I just ended minutes ago:

I'm training only the Gunner for now, and will try the other classes after I reach rank 10 with him. My Gunner is rank 8 at the moment, and I believe I was doing mission 8, a desert biome... doing it on EASY setup, all geared and perked as I could possibly be at this stage. 

I spent 3 HOURS and 3 minutes. The level size/complexity was 2.
The level was WAY TOO BIG for a solo, and a solo player THAT CANNOT SAVE THE GAME. 
Why is that? It's solo. Please make the possibility of saving the game for solo players, even if only one save per session. 

I spent 3 hours LOST in the desert, because the scanner/map is a bit horrible in such a huge dark, dark level. I love the mining aspect, I go for everything I find because it's fun and there is no time limit. You got it perfect there.

However, after 3 hours, I was so very tired because I couldn't save the game, so I had to force myself to finish it. I had done all the requirements and bonus by then. 

Before punching that Mule button, I called a Supply Drop: the drop drilled the level from top to bottom vertically, as usual. I restocked everything, and punched the button on the Mule to request my ship to start the end of my game session...

What happened next, almost brought me to tears.
The Mule was recalled, and started going away... and it chose a path through the vertical shaft drilled by the supply drop...! 

The Mule traversed the level vertically, from the very bottom to the top. A level of size 2 is already way too big for a solo player playing the Gunner, and that happening, I just could never, EVER reach the ship in time. 

Three hours of gaming, with everything absolutely done, ended with a "Failed" state.
You cannot imagine how frustrated I am right now, so tired and so frustrated with this ending.
I am loving your game, and I will keep on loving it for a very long time, I'm sure. 

But PLEASE rethink a better map generation for solo players, a save function for solo, and a mule that will follow a humanly possible path in the end, especially in solo.
Thank you for reading this."

This game got my peak interest on a PAX Event and I loved how everything was presented and graphics aren't too powerful to crash your computer or anything. 

(Well for me anyways)

Anyways, Rock and Stone!
